answer.answer: Sediment concentration (pieces/kg dry weight) and water column concentration (pieces/m3) are measured in fundamentally different units and matrices, so they cannot be directly compared to judge which site is 'more polluted'. These metrics reflect different environmental compartments and require matrix-specific benchmarks rather than a numeric ranking.
